source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-11

procedures.title: Door hinges: adjust door
steps: Reinstall the striker, trim pads and panels.
Lubricate the door hinges with Lubriplate or equivalent.
notes: After any door adjustment, check window and lock pillar alignment and correct as needed.
Check lock and striker engagement before slamming the door; it may need adjusting.

procedures.title: Door trim panel and inside handles: remove and install
steps: Use tool J-7797 to pull the clips holding the window crank and lock control (see figure 26 in the manual).
Remove the 4 screws at the inside corners of the inner door panel.
Pry the trim panel off carefully at the plastic fastener clips around its edge.
Remove the 1 screw and slide the door lock handle forward to remove it (see figure 27 in the manual).
Peel the formed plastic polyurethane cover off along its adhesive bead.
Install in reverse order, aligning the trim panel properly.

procedures.title: Door weatherstrip: install
steps: Clean off all dirt, loose paint and old cement before fitting new weatherstrip.
Use only a quality cement the maker rates for weatherstrip.
notes: Figure 28 in the manual shows mounting location.

procedures.title: Window outer seal assembly: remove and install
steps: Remove the 2 screws at the seal ends (see figure 29 in the manual).
Pry gently at the 6 retaining clips.
Lift the seal out and up.
To install, engage the clips and fit the 2 screws.

procedures.title: Window inner seal assembly: remove and install
steps: Take off the door trim panel.
Remove the 6 screws on the top of the inner door panel holding the seal tabs (see figure 29 in the manual).
Lift the seal up and rotate it outward, working the tabs through the opening.
